column2: Parameters <fileIndex> the index of the file to be read from the MMS in the buffer，i.e. the parameter <fileIndex> in “AT+CMMSRECV” and “AT+CMMSVIEW” <name> the file name to be read <datSize> the size of the file to be read.
Note If the file type is text, the character set of the output text is Unicode little endian without the header “FF FE”.
